aggregate_formula.current_concept_quality_calibration: unreviewed raw estimates are shrunk toward 50 by observed metadata reliability; reviewed neither cases are capped at 45; reviewed successes retain raw estimates
aggregate_formula.current_concept_quality_raw: observable concept dimensions minus generic, overload, and misinterpretation penalties
aggregate_formula.generation_priority: 45% inherent + 35% calibrated current concept + 20% inverse generic/misinterpretation risk
aggregate_formula.inherent_visualisability: mean(concept_immediacy, symbolic_clarity, emotional_impact, composition_potential, static_image_suitability, visual_distinctiveness) scaled to 0-100, minus text-dependency and misinterpretation penalties

basis: 40 blinded Medium/High reviews including 18 neither cases

grades.A: inherent >=75, concept >=68, static suitability >=4, generic and misinterpretation risks <=3
grades.C: inherent >=40 or a viable historical/symbolic treatment exists
grades.D: otherwise; also forced when static suitability <=1, text dependency >=4, and concept immediacy <=2

observable_mappings.concept_count_to_symbolic_clarity: 0/1/2/3+ concrete concepts map to 1/2/3/4, with a fifth point for named visible symbols
observable_mappings.risks: counts of explicit mistakes/avoidances, abstraction terms, portrait-only preferences, and historical constraints
